Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Bangladesh Women looked confident with the ball, more energetic on the field and it will be interesting to see how they approach this chase.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! West Indies Women face a challenging task ahead. They have been quite decent with the ball and have been terrific in the field as well. Can they defend this total? Or will Bangladesh Women cause yet another upset? We will find out. Stay tuned!

Salma Khatun is up for a quick chat. She says that the wicket is really good. Tells that the spinners are getting some turn. Informs that they tried to bowl wicket-to-wicket lines. Mentions that they have good batters and they believe they can chase this down.

Batting woes continue for West Indies Women. If it was not for Shemaine Campbelle, West Indies Women would have probably not been able to set a target of 141. They did get to a slow start, but they remained wicketless at the beginning. But after that, they kept tumbling like a pack of cards. There was no batter who found their rhythm in the middle, other than Shemaine Campbelle. She scored a fine half-century and helped West Indies Women put up a decent total. The bowlers do not have a lot to fight for, but they will need to put their best foot forward and try to defend this total and help West Indies Women get back to winnings ways.

The bowlers did justify their skipper's decision to bowl first. It was spin to win for Bangladesh Women! Jahanara Alam began the proceedings by grabbing the first wicket, but since then it's been only the spinners who have been doing their magic. All the spinners combined bowled a total of 34 overs, gave away just 76 runs, and grabbed 5 wickets!  Salma Khatun and Nahida Akter were exceptional as they grabbed two wickets each and were economical as well. Rumana Ahmed was impressive as well, she did pick a wicket and gave away just 11 runs in her 6 overs. They will be a tad disappointed though, after leaking a few extra runs in the final overs. But, they do have a bright chance to get their second win in the tournament.

End of a scintillating bowling performance from Bangladesh Women. Who would say they are playing their first World Cup? They have restricted West Indies for a below-par score. Although it's been a decent recovery from West Indies Women as the last few overs did go their way, which helped them reach the 140 mark. However, they face an uphill task from here on.

Short of a length, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle swipes it to wide of long on. She pushes hard fort the second run and gets it comfortably. Terrific performance from Bangladesh Women! West Indies Women finish with 140/9.

OUT! RUN OUT! Short of a length, slower and outside off. Shemaine Campbelle shimmies down and swings across the line but fails to connect. She calls Ramharack for a single. The keeper gets a direct hit at the striker's end and Ramharack is short of her ground. The umpire take it upstairs but to the naked eye, it looked clear out and the replay confirms the same.
Another run out chance! A direct-hit at the striker's end by the keeper. The replay shows that Karishma Ramharack was well short of her ground.
Length ball, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle throws the kitchen sink at it but misses.

FOUR! What a knock Shemaine Campbelle has played under pressure! Very important runs these! Short of a length again, down leg. Shemaine Campbelle swivel-pulls it to deep backward square leg for a boundary. Her second fifty of the tournament.
Short of a length, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle pulls it to deep mid-wicket. She pushes hard for the second run and gets it. Good running!
A dot! Touch fuller, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle watches it and lets it go thinking that it might be a wide.
Fariha Trisna will bowl the final over of the innings.
A low full toss, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle drives it to long on for a single and retains the strike. She moves to 47! Can she help West Indies Women go past 140?
This is good death bowling! Length ball, again well ouside off but inside the tramline. Shemaine Campbelle with a hard slash but to no success.
Short of a length, outside off, just inside the tramline. Shemaine Campbelle goes for the cut but connects it with thin air.
Length ball, on off. Karishma Ramharack mistimes her heave to mid off for a sharp single.

Mix-up...but no harm done! Another length ball, around middle. Karishma Ramharack taps it towards the left of the bowler. Shemaine Campbelle wants a single there, but she is sent back by her partner. Jahanara Alam fumbles to collect the ball, which allows Shemaine Campbelle to come back in safely.
Length ball, angling in, around middle. Karishma Ramharack pushes it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Flatter ball, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle punches it towards covers and sets off for a quick single as she wants to keep the strike. The fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end and Bangladesh Women appeal for a run out. Meanwhile, the batters take another run off the deflection. The third umpire checks and it shows that Shemaine Campbelle's dive saved her and she was in when the bails went off.
Is that a run out? There is a direct-hit at the bowler's end. Karishma Ramharack dives to make her ground, and the replay confirms that was she safe. NOT OUT says the third umpire!
This is nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses up, on off. Karishma Ramharack pushes it back to the bowler.
Around off, Karishma Ramharack dabs it to short third man.
Full and on off, driven to long off for a single.
Floats it up, outside off, drifting away. Shemaine Campbelle misses her cut.
Outside off, tapped to point for a single.

FOUR! Last couple of overs have gone West Indies' way! Fraction short and outside off, Campbelle cracks it straight to Salma Khatun at cover and she does not bend down. Let's it through her legs and the ball races away.
Put down! Floats it up, on middle. Karishma Ramharack smacks it back to the bowler. Nahida Akter fails to hold on and the ball rolls to cover for a single.
Flatter, on off. Karishma Ramharack tries to punch it. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a brace.
Shemaine Campbelle comes down the track and takes this floated delivery on the full, drives it to long off for a single.
Shemaine Campbelle makes room and cuts this loopy ball to point.
Fraction short, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to sweeper cover and retains the strike.
Flatter, on off. Shemaine Campbelle dabs it to point.

FOUR! Bangladesh Women cannot afford to let West Indies Women score runs freely after doing all the good work. Salma Khatun sprays this one down leg and Shemaine Campbelle helps it along the way to fine leg for a boundary.
Quicker and on off, Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to point.

Comes'round the wicket and bowls a length ball, on middle. Karishma Ramharack works it to mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder throws it to the bowler but the bounce gets too big on Salma Khatun and she fails to collect it.
Short and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Outside off, knocked towards covers.
Shemaine Campbelle punches this flatter ball to the off side for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers for a single.
This is eased down to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Shemaine Campbelle defends.

Missed stumping! Flighted delivery, outside off, turning away, extra bounce as well. Shemaine Campbelle dances down the track and looks to go big but misses to connect. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and allows Shemaine Campbelle to get back to the crease.
Fuller in length, on middle. Karishma Ramharack offer a block with a straight bat.
Short of a length, down leg, Karishma Ramharack looks to work it on the leg side but misses. She gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full and outside off, Karishma Ramharack pushes it towards covers.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for West Indies Women! Length ball going down leg, Karishma Ramharack misses her flick. The keeper fails to collect it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Karishma Ramharack comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bangladesh Women have their eighth wicket. Afy Fletcher walks back now. Ritu Moni strikes this time. This was the only partnership that was building but Bangladesh Women made sure they broke it at the right time. Ritu Moni serves this on a shorter length, around middle. Afy Fletcher stays back and pulls this one. But she does so with the inner half of the bat since there was no timing on that shot. The ball lobs up and goes towards Fahima Khatun at mid-wicket. She dives forward and takes a sharp low catch. The umpires check if her fingers were underneath the ball. The third umpire does confirm that it was a clean catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Fahima Khatun b Ritu Moni

Commentary.Commentary: The umpires have sent a catch referal upstairs. The soft signal is OUT. Khatun was confident that she got her fingers underneath. The third umpire has a look at different angles and confirms that Fahima Khatun does have her fingers underneath the ball. OUT shows the big screen.
Shorter ball now, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish ball, around middle. Afy Fletcher heaves it across the line past mid-wicket. The ball will not go all the way, but the batters pick up three runs. 100 up for West Indies Women!
Flighted delivery, around middle and leg. Afy Fletcher flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Firing it down the leg side, fuller ball. Afy Fletcher looks to tuck this away, but the ball brushes off her pads and goes towards the keeper.
Another short ball, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle once again cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Shorter ball now, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle stays back and cuts it towards point.
FOUR! A boundary after 8 overs! Much needed! A fuller ball, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle shimmies down the pitch and drills it down the ground for a boundary.
Much shorter now, outside off. Afy Fletcher stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Fuller in length, outside off. Pushed to cover. Just 2 runs from the over!
On a length, outside off. Afy Fletcher punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Firing it on the pads, on a fuller length. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller now, angling in around the pads. Shemaine Campbelle looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her front pad. Ritu Moni appeals for an LBW but not given. Going down leg.
Shorter, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it towards point. No run there!
Fuller now, around middle. Shemaine Campbelle pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller, outside off. Afy Fletcher drives it towards cover.
Shorter now, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it towards cover for a single.
Loopy delivery, full, outside off. Afy Fletcher sweeps it towards square leg for single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Afy Fletcher pushes it towards mid on.
Bangladesh Women have taken a review for an LBW. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is clipping over the leg stump. The original decision stands. Bangladesh Women lose a review.

NOT OUT! Huge appeal for LBW, but turned down! Another loopy ball, full again, on the pads this time. Afy Fletcher looks to flick this away, but she misses and gets hit on the front pad. Bangladesh Women do go for the review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shoes the ball was going over the wickets. The on-field decision stands.
Slower through the air, loopy ball, full, outside off. Afy Fletcher drives it towards cover.
Fuller, outside off. Driven towards covers.
Short of a length, outside off. Afy Fletcher cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and on off, Shemaine Campbelle knocks it to long on for one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
West Indies Women are now working in singles and doubles here! They know they need to change gears soon. Full, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle works it to deep square leg for a brace.
Full and on middle, jammed out.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack now.
Fraction short and outside off, Fletcher cuts it in front of square on the off side and Campbelle pushes for the second again, gets it comfortably in the end.
Shemaine Campbelle comes down the track and squeezes this tossed up ball to long on for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Shemaine Campbelle drags her sweep to square leg.

In the air, but safe! Loopy ball, on middle. Afy Fletcher shimmies down and heaves but could not time it well. The ball stays in the air but lands safely in front of the long on fielder. The batters take a run.
Short and on off, defended back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery, on off. Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and pushes it to long on for a single.
Fahima Khatun (5-1-6-0) comes back into the attack.
Slower, on middle. Afy works it to mid-wicket.
Good running! Short and on middle, Afy Fletcher camps back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. She calls for the second run and gets it easily.
Short and on middle, Afy Fletcher smashes it back to the bowler again.
Flighted ball, outside off. Afy Fletcher defends it back to the bowler.
Quicker, outside off. Afy Fletcher misses her slash.
Floats it up, outside off. Nicely dabbed to third man for a single.
Slower through the air, outside off. Afy Fletcher gets low and slogs it to long on for a brace.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Afy Fletcher nudges it to mid on.
Slight halt in play! Nahida Akter seems to have hurt her finger while trying to stop the ball. The physio is out there to check on her. She seems fine now and we are ready to resume.
Full and on off, Afy Fletcher chips it back to the bowler. Falls just short of Nahida Akter!
Close! Short and around off, Afy Fletcher rocks back and looks to push it away but misses once again.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Afy Fletcher misses her cut shot.
Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and pushes this loopy ball to mid on for a run.
Full and on off, Afy Fletcher prods and defends it to the off side.
On off, blocked towards covers.
Gone past the second slip! Loopy ball, outside off, turning away. Afy Fletcher rocks back and looks to cut. The ball goes off the outside edge and flies past second slip for a brace.

DRINKS! Bangladesh Women have continued to trouble the West Indies Women. No batters have been to find their rhythm in the middle. It's been a magical start for Bangladesh Women. West Indies Women have been struggling against spin, they do have 15 overs left and they be hoping they go on till the end and add some valuable runs. Afy Fletcher comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another soft dismissal for West Indies Women! Wickets keep falling like a pack of cards for them. Bangladesh Women bossing this game. Salma Khatun with a flighted delivery, on middle. Chinelle Henry goes for the lofted shot but could not middle it. She hits it off the higher part of the bat back to the bowler and Salma Khatun does not drop those. She pouches it comfortably to send Chinelle Henry packing.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Chinelle Henry looks to cut it away but misses. This is sensational bowling from Bangladesh Women!
Full and on off, Shemaine Campbelle steps out and works it on the leg side for a single.
Beaten! Fuller ball, loopy delivery, turns away, outside off. Chinelle Henry leans to block this but she misses.
Another loopy ball, outside off, fuller again. Chinelle Henry pushes it back to the cover.
Slower through the air now, fuller ball, outside off. Chinelle Henry leans and drives it towards cover.
Swing and a miss! Tad shorter now, outside off. Chinelle Henry hangs back and tries to cut this away, but she misses.
Outside off, fuller ball. Left alone.
Beaten! This one lands on a fuller length, turns away, outside off. Chinelle Henry looks to block this ut she beaten on the outside edge.
Very full this time, slower through the air, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle pushes it towards mid on.
Outside off, tad fuller. Shemaine Campbelle stays back and looks to chop this but misses.
Shorter ball, outside off. Chinelle Henry hangs back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and clips it to mid on for a single.
Outside off, cut to point.

FOUR! Shemaine Campbelle finally breaks the shackles. A rare boundary, first in over 20 overs! Full and on off, Shemaine Campbelle shimmies down and smashes it past the bowler to long off for a welcome boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Chinelle Henry keeps it out.
Outside off, Henry looks to go big but fails to connect.
On the pads, Shemaine Campbelle shuffles across and gloves the sweep past the keeper, Henry was late to call for the single but she makes it in without any harm.
Flighted delivery, Shemaine Campbelle hangs back and defends.
Fraction short, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it but straight to cover-point.
Tossed up, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle looks to push but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Chinelle Henry walks out to bat.

West Indies Women have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching outside off, the impact is in line and it is wickets hitting. THREE REDS! The on-field decision stays.

OUT! LBW! Another goes back to the hut and West Indies Women continues to tumble! Bangladesh Women have grabbed their sixth and Rumana Ahmed gets her first wicket. A shorter ball, this one comes back in, on the pads. Aaliyah Alleyne hangs back and tries to flick this on the leg side, but she misses as the ball turns back in and gets rapped on her pads. The umpire raises her finger immediately after the appeal. Aaliyah Alleyne does opt for a review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows three reds and Aaliyah Alleyne does have to walk back!
Around off, fuller ball. Aaliyah Alleyne blocks it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne hangs back and tries to cut this once again, but she gets ann bottom edge back onto the deck.
Flatter ball, around middle. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Shorter this time, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle hangs back and tries to cut this away, but gets a bottom edge back onto the deck.
Tosses it up, on middle, fuller ball. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Loopy ball, full, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne drives it towards cover.
Full, on middle. Aaliyah Alleyne pushes it back to the bowler.
Tad shorter now, outside ff. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it past point for a single.
Loopy ball again, full, around off. Shemaine Campbelle drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Fuller now, around off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out towards cover.
In the air... and just short! Shorter ball, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it and the ball lobs up and lands just short of the fielder at cover-point.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne covers the stumps and lets it go. Yet another maiden! It's all Bangladesh Women at the moment.
Short and on off, cut to point.
Aaliyah Alleyne uses her feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to mid on.
Flighted delivery, on off. Aaliyah Alleyne tucks it to mid on.
Aaliyah Alleyne steps out and drives this loopy ball to extra cover.
Short and outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne goes for the cut shot but misses.
Another maiden! Tossed up, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle prods and looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is cut to point.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle stays in her crease and cuts it towards point.
Another tossed up ball, full again, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle has pushed it back to the bowler once again.
Loopy delivery, full again, around off. Shemaine Campbelle pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, around off. Shemaine Campbelle blocks it out.
Flighted delivery full again, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne has pushed this to the fielder at cover.
Aaliyah Alleyne walks out to bat now.

OUT! RUN OUT! West Indies Women needed to take risks but not sure this was the right way. Rumana Ahmed bowls it on a shorter length, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle hangs back and cuts it to cover-point and sets off for a quick single. Bangladesh Women have been excellent in the field so far and this was another example of that. Fargana Hoque shows her brilliance by moving to her right quickly. She picks the ball one-handed and fires a bullet throw at the striker's end. She scores a direct hit and Chedean Nation is caught well short of her crease despite putting a desperate full-stretched dive. She lays there on the ground with her face buried. Amazing fielding and Bangladesh Women are loving it. Half the side back in the hut now for just 60 runs!
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Both the batters are struggling to rotate the strike! On off, blocked out by Shemaine Campbelle.
Outside off, on a shorter length. Nation punches it towards covers for a single.
Floats it up, on off. Chedean Nation rocks back and defends.
Given some loop, full and on off. Played to mid on. Another tidy over from Fahima Khatun!
Tossed up, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it to the off side.
Loopy ball, outside off, Nation punches it off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Chedean Nation presses forward and blocks.
Short and outside off, Chedean Nation hangs back and knocks it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle prods and works it to mid on for a quick single.
Loopy ball, around off. Chedean Nation defends it out.
Loopy ball, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it to short mid-wicket for a quick single. A direct hit at the bowler's end and it could have been curtains for Shemaine Campbelle.
On off, blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Floats it up, on off. Shemaine Campbelle stays solid in her defence.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle makes room and cuts it towards covers but not in the gap.
Just a single off it! Full, outside off. Nation defends it to cover.
Flighted, full and on off. Chedean Nation uses her feet to push it back to the bowler.
Full, outside off. Nation prods and defends it into the deck.
Short, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it through covers for a single. It has been 72 deliveries since the last boundary for West Indies.
On off, defended out.
Flighted, full, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle taps it to cover.
Full, on off. Chedean Nation defends it out watchfully.
Darted on the pads. Shemaine Campbelle clips it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full, on off, blocked out on the front foot.
Very full, on off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Angled into the pads, Shemaine Campbelle comes down the track and tries to flick it away but misses. She gets pinged on her pads. Going down leg.
Looped up, full, on off. Nation pushes it to the left of mid on for a single.
Rumana Ahmed comes into the attack now.
Fuller, on off. Shemaine Campbelle prods and defends it out watchfully.
Tossed up, on off. Shemaine Campbelle works it back to the bowler.
A single now! Length, on off. Nation punches it through covers for one. A rare run for West Indies, this.
Flighted, outside off. Nation goes back and pushes it to cover.
Tossed up, on off. Nation pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller, outside off. Nation pushes it to cover.

Another maiden for Bangladesh Women. Short and wide outside off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it hard to the off side but unable to find the gap. Only 2 runs have come in the last 5 overs for West Indies Women. This is some bowling by Bangladesh Women. Excellent!
Full, on the stumps. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out on her front foot.
Looped up, full and outside off. Shemaine Campbelle leaves it alone for the keeper.
Outside off, worked towards cover yet again.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it to cover.
Fuller, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle slashes it to point.
On off, pushed to cover. A maiden now for Fahima Khatun. Her first of the innings as well. Bangladesh have done extremely well to pull things back in their favour.
Five dots in a row now! This is a beautiful delivery. Flighted, full and outside off. Chedean Nation tries to defend it out but misses. She gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floated, full and outside off. Chedean Nation pushes it to cover.
Make it three now! Fuller, on off. Chedean Nation prods to defend it into the deck.
Two dots in a row now! Looped up, outside off, with some extra bounce off the deck. Chedean Nation goes back and leaves it alone for the keeper.
Short, outside off. Chedean Nation cuts it hard but straight to point.
This one comes back in, outside off, touch shorter. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to the fielder at cover-point.
Flighted delivery, pitches it up, around middle. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Turning away, outside off, short in length. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it towards point.
Loopy ball, around middle, much fuller. Chedean Nation pushes it off the front foot past mid off for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Chedean Nation drives it towards cover.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Chedean Nation defends it out.
Shorter ball, again, slower through the air, outside off. Chedean Nation cuts it past point for a single.
Another loopy ball, outside off. Chedean Nation cuts it towards point.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Chedean Nation defends it off the back foot.
Flatter ball, outside off, tosses it up again. Chedean Nation leans to defend, but she misses.
Another flighted delivery, a leg spinner. Chedean Nation taps it towards over, off the back foot.
Spinning it away, fuller ball, tosses it up. Chedean Nation pushes it towards cover.
Change. Fahima Khatun comes into the attack now.
Flighted delivery, full, around middle. Shemaine Campbelle has pushed this back to the bowler. A maiden over!
Turning back in, around middle, fuller ball. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Loopy ball, around off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Fuller now, around off. Shemaine Campbelle blocks it out.
Shorter ball now, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle chops it towards cover-point.
Beaten! Loopy ball, outside off, fuller ball. Shemaine Campbelle leans and tries to block this but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Outside off, shorter ball. Chedean Nation cuts it to the fielder at point.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Chedean Nation pushes it back to the bowler.
Good fielding! Short again, spinning away, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle slashes it towards cover-point. The fielder there dives to her right and makes a good stop. Single taken!
Tad shorter, turning away, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle pushes it towards cover.
Wide! Loopy ball, down the leg side this time, on a fuller length. Shemaine Campbelle looks to sweep this but misses. Wide called!
Slower through the air, full again, around off. Shemaine Campbelle leans and blocks it out.
Spinning away, full, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle defends it out.
Full and on off. Chedean Nation defends it on her front foot. Now, Salma Khatun with a wicket-maiden over. Bangladesh dictating terms at the moment.
On off, Nation defends it out solidly.
Fuller, on off, Chedean Nation defends it on her front foot.
On off, pushed to cover.

DROPPED! It is a tough chance though. Looped up, full and outside off. Chedean Nation flirts away from her body. It take the outside edge and flies to the left of second slip. The fielder there dives to that side with her left hand stretched out. The ball sticks in but spills out as well with ease.
Chedean Nation is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another bites the dust! Bangladesh Women are all over West Indies Women here! Salma Khatun strikes this time. Loopy ball, full, outside off. Rashada Williams leans and looks to drive but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat and lobs up towards cover-point. Fargana Hoque takes an easy there to dismiss Rashada Williams. West Indies Women lose their fourth wicket in quick succession!
Commentary.Howout: c Fargana Hoque b Salma Khatun

Commentary.Commentary: A wicket maiden for Nahida Akter. Touch short, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle hangs back but cuts it straight to point.

DRINKS! What a start this has been for Bangladesh Women! The bowlers have justified the skipper's decision to bowl first. They have been excellent with the bowl, they have kept things tight and have grabbed three wickets. West Indies Women are in a some sort of trouble here, they need to build a partnership. Also, Shemaine Campbelle comes to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Nahida Akter picks up her second wicket in her second over. Bangladesh Women clearly on top at the moment. Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, goes back on a timid score. It is looped up, full and down the leg side. Stafanie Taylor gets low, tries to sweep it away but fails to get any blade on it. The ball pitches outside leg and turns in a bit to clip the leg pole. But, Stafanie Taylor does not realise it. The Bangladesh players are celebrating leaving a confused look of Stafanie Taylor's face. The umpires converge and later come to a conclusion that it is a clean wicket.
Full and on off. Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
Around off, Taylor blocks it out watchfully.
Short, on off. Taylor goes back and punches it to cover.
Tossed up, on off, blocked out.
Full, on off. Rashada Williams defends it out solidly.
Looped up, outside off. Rashada Williams guides it through backward point for two more.
EDGED...but safe! Floated, fuller, outside off. Rashada Williams tries to punch it away. The ball takes the outside edge and flies past the slip fielder. They take two before the fielder cuts it off.
On off, pushed to cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Rashada Williams works it to the right of first slip off the outer half. No trouble for the batter though.
BEATEN! Looped up, outside off. Rashada Williams tries to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On off, blocked out solidly.
Tosses it up again, full, around middle and leg this time. Stafanie Taylor looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto the pads.
Loopy ball, full, outside off. Stafanie Taylor presses forward and blocks it out.
FOUR! Stafanie Taylor gets off the mark in style! Shorter all, spinning away, outside off. Stafanie Taylor hangs back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Slower through the air, full, on middle. Stafanie Taylor defends it out.
Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! OH MY GOD! What a stunning catch by Nigar Sultana at short mid-wicket. Nahida Akter strikes on her very first delivery. It is a touch short, on off. Hayley Matthews goes on the back foot, tries to pull it away over short mid-wicket but does not time it to perfection. Nigar Sultana leaps at short mid-wicket to gather the ball safely and does not let it burst out of her fingers. West Indies Women lose their second wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Nigar Sultana b Nahida Akter

Commentary.Commentary: Spin from both ends now! Nahida Akter comes to bowl now.
Fuller, outside off. Rashada Williams does not get tempted and leaves it alone for the keeper.
Floated, full, just outside off. Rashada Williams opens her face of the blade late and taps it to point.
Fuller, on off. Williams comes down the track to push it back to the bowler.
A single now as this worked down to long on.
Length, on off. Hayley Matthews gets it back to the bowler on a bounce.
Looped up, full outside off, Hayley Matthews prods and defends it to cover.
Time for some spin! Salma Khatun comes into the attack.

FOUR LEG BYES! Full length, angling down leg. Rashada Williams tries to flick it off her pads but misses. It clips the pads, beats the keeper and races away to the fine leg boundary. The umpire signals leg byes.
Overpitched, outside off. Rashada Williams pushes it to mid off on the front foot.
Length ball, on off, blocked out solidly.
Fuller, outside off. Hayley Matthews taps it to cover and takes off for a quick single.
Two dots in a row! Full length, outside off. Hayley Matthews drives it to covers but is unable to find the gap on the off side.
On a length, outside off. Hayley Matthews pushes it towards mid off.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the 40th over.
Very full, angling in, on middle. Rashada Williams pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Rashada Williams leaves it alone.
Angling in, down the leg side, on a length. Hayley Matthews tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Very full again, outside off this time. Hayley Matthews leans and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Hayley Matthews motoring along really well. Length ball, around off. Hayley Matthews punches it through covers for a boundary.
Full, swinging in, around middle. Hayley Matthews drives it to mid on.
Length, on off, pushed out.
Full length, on off. Rashada Williams blocks it on her front foot.
Rashada Williams is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Jahanara Alam strikes and draws first blood! Bangladesh Women have an early breakthrough! They get rid of Deandra Dottin! Shorter ball, just outside off. Deandra Dottin hangs back and tries to cut this away, but she gets cramped for room and manages to get an outside edge back to the keeper. Shamima Sultana pouches it safely. Bangladesh Women jump in delight! High-fives all-around! This wicket truly means a lot.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamima Sultana b Jahanara Alam

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off. Deandra Dottin pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Very full this time, around middle. Deandra Dottin shows the full face of her bat and drives it past mid on for a boundary!
Shortish ball, outside off. Deandra Dottin punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Another length delivery, angling in, around middle and leg. Hayley Matthews tucks it towards square leg.
Another lovely inswinger, on middle and on a length. Hayley Matthews pushes this to mid on off the back foot.
Wide! On the leg side now, on a length. Hayley Matthews looks to pull this but she misses.
On a length, swinging in, on middle. Hayley Matthews stays in her crease and gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews pushes it towards cover-point. This is good bowling from Fariha Trisna!
Full in length again, outside off. Hayley Matthews drives it to the fielder at cover.
Very full now, on middle. Hayley Matthews drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Hayley Matthews nudges it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. She retains the strike!
Pitches it up this time, on middle. Deandra Dottin knocks it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, angling in, on middle. Hayley Matthews tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Hayley Matthews knocks it back to the bowler.
Swing and a miss! Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Hayley Matthews stays in her crease and tries to cut this but misses.
On a length, shaping away, outside off. Deandra Dottin punches it past mid off for a single.
Much fuller now, around middle. Hayley Matthews works it away towards mid-wicket once again. A maiden over!
On a length, angling in, around middle and leg. Hayley Matthews pushes it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Make that 4! Tad fuller now, on middle. Hayley Matthews pushes it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery, another inswinger, around middle. Hayley Matthews works it away towards square leg. 3 dots in a row!
Pitches it up this time, angling in, around middle. Hayley Matthews drives it towards mid on.
On a length, swinging it in, around middle. Hayley Matthews pushes it towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
Not able to penetrate the field. Full length, on off. Dottin drives it to covers but unable to send it away to the boundary.
Around off, worked to cover.
On a length, outside off. Dottin punches it to the off side.
Length ball, on off. Dottin pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Full length, on the pads. Deandra Dottin clips it through the gap at square leg for four.
FOUR! Punished! A short ball, outside off. Deandra Dottin goes on the back foot and cuts it hard through covers to bag a boundary.
Just 4 runs off the over. Fariha Trisna with a really good comeback in this over after being hit for a boundary on the first delivery. Hayley Matthews defends this length ball solidly.
Fariha Trisna keeping things tight with the ball. Length ball, on middle and leg. Hayley Matthews tucks it to square leg.
Very full, on middle. Matthews eases it back to the bowler.
Fuller, just outside off. Matthews drives it into covers.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR Some width on offer and Hayley Matthews makes the most of it. A length ball, outside, shaping across the right-hander. Hayley Matthews goes back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Four dots on the trot to end the over! Fuller, on off. Dottin drives it to cover. Not in the gap though.
Full length, outside off. Dottin drives it crisply into covers. A fielder does well to make a sharp stop on her left.
Back of a length, outside off. Dottin hangs back, tries to cut it away but gets it to hit the deck off the inner half.
On a length, on off. Dottin eases it back to the bowler.
Length ball, sliding down the leg side. Dottin stays back and flicks it to deep square leg. They take two with ease.
Fuller, on the pads. Dottin clips it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, on off, defended out watchfully.
FOUR! Down the ground. A length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews goes back and punches it past the bowler. It beats the fielder at mid off and races away to the boundary.
Inswinging, full and on leg. Hayley Matthews clips it to the leg side.
Good length, on top of off. Hayley Matthews stands tall and pushes it to mid on with a straight bat.
Full length, an inswinger, around middle and leg. Hayley Matthews flicks it to the leg side.
Full length, on middle and leg. Hayley Matthews tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fariha Trisna will bowl from the other end.
Good length, on off. Hayley Matthews pushes it to cover. A fielder dives to her right to make a half-stop. Matthews gets off the mark now. A tidy start by Jahanara Alam with the ball.
Length, on middle and leg. Hayley Matthews gets it to mid on not in the gap though.
Full length, on off. Matthews works it gently towards mid off.
Length ball, on off, pushed to covers with ease.

Deandra Dottin and West Indies Women are off the mark. A length delivery, around off, shaping away a bit late. Deandra Dottin gets squared up inside the crease. Deandra Dottin gets it towards backward point off the outer half. One taken.
A dot to start with! On a length, on off. Dottin defends it to cover.

We are done with the pre-match formalities and are ready to get the ball rolling. The players now take their respective fielding positions. Hayley Matthews and Deandra Dottin are the openers for West Indies Women. Jahanara Alam will start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
The match officials and both teams stride out for the national anthem. It will be West Indies' national anthem first followed by Bangladesh's.

PITCH REPORT - Lydia Greenway is near the pitch. She says that it is very dry and there is hardly any live grass. Mentions that spinners will play a big role here. Informs that mixing up the pace will be key for the spinners.

Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, says its a good wicket and they do not mind batting first. Mentions that they last two games were hard ones, but she says that the way they bowled against Australia was something positive. Adds that they are known for the exciting brand of cricket and hopefully, they can bring a fight today. Informs that they have two changes to their side.

Nigar Sultana, the skipper of Bangladesh Women, says that they will bowl first. Mentions that it's a fresh wicket, so they wanted to take advantage of the first 10 overs since they are a good bowling side. Tells that girls are excited about this game. Informs that they are going with the same team.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews, Rashada Williams (In for Kycia Knight), Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle (WK), Chedean Nation, Aaliyah Alleyne, Chinelle Henry, Afy Fletcher (In for Shakera Selman) Karishma Ramharack, Shamilia Connell.

Bangladesh Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Shamima Sultana (WK), Sharmin Akhter, Fargana Hoque, Nigar Sultana (C), Rumana Ahmed, Ritu Moni, Fahima Khatun, Salma Khatun, Nahida Akter, Jahanara Alam, Fariha Trisna.
TOSS - Bangladesh Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Bangladesh on the other hand lost their opening two fixtures against South Africa Women and the White Ferns. However, they staged a remarkable comeback to steal a morale-boosting win over Asian rivals Pakistan in a thrilling contest. It was also their maiden World Cup victory and that has given them a lot of confidence heading further in the tournament. They would be looking to create a similar upset and make a statement facing the Caribbeans. So will Bangladesh Women get another victory? Or will West Indies Women bounce back? We shall find out. Stick around for the toss and team news.

After getting a dream start by defeating the hosts, New Zealand and the defending champions, England, West Indies Women went on to suffer two back-to-back losses. They failed to perform better in their last two matches and now would be keen to bounce back and strengthen their position in the points table with a win. Batters' failures in their last 2 matches have cost them immensely and would be looking to perform better with the bat this time around.

Hello everyone! A warm welcome to match 17 of the Women's Cricket World Cup where Bangladesh Women will take on West Indies Women. Both teams come into the contest on the back of contrasting results in the previous encounters. With two important points up for grabs, another entertaining game beckons at Bay Oval.
... MATCH DAY ...
